Config Navigator

An IntelliJ IDEA plugin for Airlock IAM config files — the large IamConfig YAML documents that are painful to read and edit by hand.

Add this plugin repository to IntelliJ

{{REPO_URL}}

In the IDE: Settings → Plugins → ⚙ → Manage Plugin Repositories…, then paste the URL above. Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2+.

  • Navigation — jump between ref:/parentRef: and the plugin id:, with Find Usages.
  • Code completion — refs, slot-aware type: values, property names and scaffolds.
  • Quick documentation — hover a type, property or ref for its description and allowed children.
  • Inspections — dangling refs, duplicate ids, unknown/missing properties and wrong child types.
